NAME: OMat24 dataset
TYPE: component

DIRECT_CLAIMS: Training a TensorNet model on the 400 k‑structure MatPES‑PBE dataset requires approximately 15 minutes per epoch on a single RTX A6000 GPU, whereas training on the 100 M‑structure OMat24 dataset needs about 20 hours per epoch on sixteen A100 GPUs, highlighting the computational efficiency of MatPES.

DIRECT_CLAIMS: The diversity of the larger OMat24 dataset does not benefit from the regularization or augmentation provided by DeNS, whereas dataset augmentation techniques like DeNS can significantly enhance performance when training solely on the MPtraj dataset.
DIRECT_CLAIMS: Rattled systems in the OMat24 dataset have deleterious effects on model performance when evaluated on out-of-distribution hetero-diatomic systems.
ARTICLE: Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) Inorganic Materials Dataset and Models

DIRECT_CLAIMS: The Gaussian process regression framework underlying GAP provides an uncertainty quantification that qualitatively estimates the potential’s accuracy for any given atomic configuration.

DIRECT_CLAIMS: Uncertainty quantification based on latent‑space Euclidean distance provides error estimates that correlate with prediction errors, allowing exclusion of transitions whose uncertainty exceeds 50 % of the absolute free‑energy difference.
